verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Sumsub's Web/Mobile SDKs handle document capture across 14,000+ document types and support customizable instructions/tips (sumsub-docs-11, sumsub-docs-7, sumsub-docs-18), but nothing in the pack documents specific real-time capture coaching such as glare detection, blur detection, or edge/frame detection guiding the user to a usable photo. This is a fair, applicable axis for an identity-verification SDK, but no evidence substantiates the specific guided-capture mechanics described in the story.
